title: tensorfem.inverse: recovered tau / E against generating truth, ill-posed E+A control, log replay

gates.quantity: |E*A - E_true*A_true| / (E_true*A_true) with E and A both unknowns
identifiable flag of the E+A control (1 = claims E and A separately)
gates.reference: the observations contain only the product E*A, so the correct diagnosis is not identifiable

gates.quantity: effective rank of the weighted Jacobian, E+A control
gates.reference: rank 1: one identifiable combination (E*A) out of two unknowns

gates.quantity: (max tau - min tau) / tau_true over the three multi-start seeds
gates.reference: the recovered optimum must not depend on the start point

gates.quantity: convergence log of one seed replayed in the same process is bit-for-bit identical
gates.reference: the JSON-lines convergence log hash must repeat exactly

gates.quantity: a different seed reaches a different start sequence (the seed control is live)
gates.reference: seed control is wired: seed 1 and seed 2 logs must differ

gates.quantity: number of inversion runs that did not reach the convergence tolerance
gates.reference: every run must report converged before its estimate is graded

limitations: Both cases are inverse crimes in the strict sense: the data are generated by the same forward model the optimiser inverts (single exponential / 4-element truss), so the residual error is the optimiser's, not a model error; a discretisation-error study of the forward model is not attempted here.
The decay case is 1 % noisy and the axial bar 0.5 % noisy with a single noise draw per case, so the reported errors are one realisation, not an ensemble mean.
The log replay is checked in-process only (same interpreter, same process); cross-process determinism depends on torch thread scheduling and is not asserted.

The E+A control expects effective rank 1 from a weighted-Jacobian singular-value cut, which is a tolerance choice, not a theorem; the reported condition number (~4.5e11) is the tolerance-free statement.
